approaches.title: Increment digits from the right
approaches.summary: Find the rightmost digit that can be incremented, increment it, and zero any trailing nines. If every digit is nine, zero them all and prepend one.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Walk backward, increment the first digit below nine, and track whether a carry requires prepending one.

revisions.commitBody:
- appending is O(n) anyways so just insert
- insert also gives a chance to reuse the current allocation
- cleaner early escape
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Simplify carry handling with an early return; prepend one only if the loop zeroes every digit.
Use `rposition` to find the rightmost digit below nine, then increment it and zero the suffix; handle the all-nines case separately.
